answer: A VRF lottery seats 14 jurors, one per line of a sonnet, on each newcomer vertex in the identity graph. Jurors commit hashed verdicts, then reveal, and each forfeits a 20-token stake when voting against the final majority. Admission needs 10 approvals and a 30-token bond held for 30 epochs. Because seats are drawn at random, 10,000 clones demand 300,000 bonded tokens, about 150,000 USD at 0.50 USD per token, plus bribes of 5 USD for 10 jurors per clone, another 500,000 USD. Defense resembles a walled garden where every seedling needs ten gardeners to vouch for its roots.
